summary: Pair 2 (Sold-Out Waitlist + PiP) tested on backend + web + mobile. Waitlist join/idempotent/leave/my-waitlist/wrong-advertiser-404/storefront-regression/episode-media all PASS (8/9 backend). One CRITICAL frontend bug: the WEB /podcasts/:podcast_id route renders pages/PodcastDetail.jsx (testids like podcast-episode-play-<id>), NOT design_radiolife/screens/PodcastDetailRadioLife.jsx where the new Watch button + PiP overlay were added (rl-podcast-episode-watch-<id>). Result: on the live web podcast page there is NO Watch button and NO PiP overlay is reachable — the entire WEB PiP feature is unreachable end-to-end. Mobile PiP button + hint render correctly. Store Remind-me works end-to-end on BOTH web and mobile (remindme→waitlisted transition verified fresh on both). Also: admin dispatch returns notified=0 because seed keeps cmp_fpk_spin sold-out — spec expected notified>=1; either seed must un-sold-out before dispatch, or dispatch must force-notify on manual admin call. Additionally, the podcast channel ch_ui_demo was NOT published in seed (missing active:true + approval_status:'approved'); testing agent flipped these directly in Mongo to unblock UI testing — the main agent should update scripts/seed_pair2_testdata.py to include this.

critical.issue: Spec expects {notified>=1} after a waiter joins for cmp_fpk_spin, but dispatch_waitlist() skips waiters when remaining_today==0 (sold out). Because scripts/seed_pair2_testdata.py maxes cmp_fpk_spin's daily_issued to cap, dispatch always returns {checked:1, notified:0} and the entry stays waiting; /api/me/notifications never gets a coupon_restock item. Either (a) auto-un-sold-out before dispatch in the seed / a test-only endpoint, or (b) make admin dispatch force-notify (ignore capacity) since a manual admin flush implies restock. RCA in routes/coupon_waitlist.py:120 -> `available = (not is_coupon) or (remaining is None) or (remaining > 0)` returns False when remaining==0.

minor.issue: Seed channel is missing active=True and approval_status='approved', so the public read returns 404 channel_not_published and the web PodcastDetail page shows an empty state. Fixed in-DB during testing; update scripts/seed_pair2_testdata.py to also set these fields.

ui_bugs.issue: The Watch button + PipVideoPlayer were added to /app/frontend/src/design_radiolife/screens/PodcastDetailRadioLife.jsx but the route in App.js:601 mounts /app/frontend/src/pages/PodcastDetail.jsx which does NOT include the Watch button, videoEp state, openVideo() call, or the PipVideoPlayer render. Actual DOM testids: podcast-episode-play-<id>, podcast-episode-title-<id> — NO rl-podcast-episode-watch-<id> and NO pip-video-overlay anywhere. WEB PiP feature is fully unreachable.

integration_issues.issue: Cannot exercise: watch button not rendered by the mounted component (see ui_bugs).

Review request specifically references this testid; add testID='mobile-episode-pip-hint' on the hint <Text> in /app/mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx for reliable automated verification.

parity_issues.expected: Both surfaces expose a Watch/PiP affordance for the seeded video episode.
parity_issues.actual: Mobile: OK (button + hint render, deferred-to-build documented). Web: no Watch button in DOM.

parity_issues.issue: Full parity — verified fresh transition on BOTH web and mobile from remindme testid to waitlisted testid.

action_items: CRITICAL: Move the Watch button + PipVideoPlayer wiring from design_radiolife/screens/PodcastDetailRadioLife.jsx into /app/frontend/src/pages/PodcastDetail.jsx (which is the actual component mounted at /podcasts/:podcast_id per App.js:601). Include: import PipVideoPlayer + openVideo helper, videoEp useState, the Watch button next to podcast-episode-play-<id> with testid rl-podcast-episode-watch-<id> (or update the spec to use podcast-episode-watch-<id>), and render <PipVideoPlayer> when videoEp is set.

HIGH: Decide waitlist dispatch semantics. Either (a) update scripts/seed_pair2_testdata.py to clear daily_issued on cmp_fpk_spin (make it 'restocked') just before dispatch, or (b) make POST /api/admin/waitlist/dispatch force-notify regardless of capacity (or accept a ?force=true query flag). Currently dispatch swallows the notify silently when the campaign is sold out — the spec expected notified>=1.

LOW: Add testID='mobile-episode-pip-hint' to the hint <Text> in /app/mobile/app/podcast/episode/[id].tsx so testers can anchor on the exact selector called out in the review request.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/coupon_waitlist.py — join is idempotent via a (user,campaign,waiting) find+insert (no unique index, so a race could double-insert; consider a partial unique index on (user_id,campaign_id) where status='waiting').
routes/coupon_waitlist.py:120 — availability gate silently drops the notify when sold out. Manual admin dispatch should probably override this (log & always notify).

routes/coupon_waitlist.py — _notify_waiter dedupe key includes _today_str(); on the SAME UTC day a re-join after dispatch will be de-duped by the notification enqueue — this is desired but worth documenting.

frontend App.js — route /podcasts/:podcast_id points at pages/PodcastDetail (legacy) while the new PiP work was done in design_radiolife/screens/PodcastDetailRadioLife.jsx. Either route to the new screen or port the new UI into the mounted one. This is the single blocking bug for WEB PiP.

PipVideoPlayer.jsx — cleanly guards on document.pictureInPictureEnabled, catches requestPictureInPicture errors, and shows a pip-video-unsupported / pip-video-error node. Code itself is correct; it's just not reachable.
